description.naturesmekanism.universal_au: Produces Aura from FE. Supports pressurized tubes and optional environmental release.
description.naturesmekanism.universal_fo: Processes forest recipes using ingredients, a sapling, gold powder and FE.
description.naturesmekanism.universal_na: Infuses ingredients using Aura and FE. Catalysts are retained.
description.naturesmekanism.universal_of: Replaces the Offering Table and requires its flower arrangement. One calling item starts a batch.
